question: The Ryotwari system was started first in which of the following Presidencies of British India?
solution:
The Correct answer is__** Madras.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ryotwari System was started first in **Madras.**
 
• The Ryotwari System was firstly Introduced by **Thomas Munro** in the year **1820.**
 
• By this system, the Government made a settlement with the cultivators by giving the government 50% of the production.
 
• This is the System of Land Revenue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Three major systems **of land revenue collection existed in India.
 
• They were –
 
 
• Zamindari.
 
• Ryotwari.
 
• Mahalwari.
